title: uMatter
info: A judgment-free wellbeing space for students
description: A safe space for students to reflect, connect, and grow.
details: uMatter is a judgment-free digital platform designed to break the stigma around school counseling and help students reflect, learn, and reach out without fear.

Built over 5 months with psychiatrists, student surveys, and ethical reviews, the front end is structured into three pillars: Learn (credible resources), Tools (habit and productivity support), and Reach Out (discreet counselor access and the Salus chatbot).
Key achievements: impacted nearly 500 students, gained attention across Mumbai schools, and presented directly to the Education Inspector of South Mumbai.

title: Biomimetic Patch Simulation
info: An interactive explainer for a frog- and octopus-inspired drug patch
description: A step-by-step visual explainer of a glue-free, self-dosing patch inspired by tree frogs and blue-ringed octopuses.
details: An interactive biomimicry explainer for a glue-free, self-dosing patch that uses tree-frog-inspired pillars for moisture-assisted grip and sweat drainage, and blue-ringed octopus-inspired gel needles that trigger drug release at body heat (35–37 °C) without a battery.

Built as a self-contained HTML, CSS, and JavaScript app featuring a scaled Canvas cross-section, six guided steps with camera transitions, live temperature and time readouts, and an SVG release curve over 48 hours.
Key lessons: scaling biological structures across micrometre-to-millimetre dimensions, pacing step-by-step visual explanations, and clearly separating illustrative behavior from real measured data.

title: scribe
info: A private notes app that never leaves your browser
description: A privacy-friendly notes app that stores everything in the browser.
details: Scribe is a lightweight notes app written in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Notes are created, edited and deleted entirely in the browser and persisted with local storage, so nothing ever leaves the device.
